sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 2 21-06-2023 Heard the parties.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The petitioner is in custody since 21.2.2023 in connection with Town Aurangabad P.S. Case No.
141of 2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 413, 414 of the I.P.C.
lodged on 20.2.2023 by the informant Sanjay Kumar.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecution story, in brief, is that on 20.2.2023, the informant received a secret information that three youngsters are standing with Pulser Motorcycle at Gagri More.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: The informant alongwith police personnel reached there and apprehended them.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: On query, they disclosed their names as Rahul Kumar, Raviraj Kumar @ Nepali and Santosh Yadav.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Upon search, a Pulser motorcycle with tampered number plate Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.31322 of 2023(2) dt.21-06-2023 and the mobile set were recovered from their possession.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: They further disclosed that the alleged motorcycle is stolen one.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he runs a tea shop at Gagri More where other co-accused persons had arrived when the police reached, he was serving tea and was caught along with them.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Further submission is that he do not have criminal antecedent.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned APP opposes the prayer.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: Considering the fact that he is in custody since 21.2.2023, has no criminal antecedent and is a young of 21 years, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of bail with conditions.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, if it is found that the petitioner do have criminal antecedent, this bail order shall become infructuous.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Let the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Aurangabad, in connection with Town Aurangabad P.S. Case No. 141of 2023
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json
Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023.json

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, the bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 2 19-08-2023 Heard the parties.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The petitioner is in custody in connection with Rahui P.S. Case No. 489 of 2022 for the offence under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120 of the Indian Penal Code and 30(a)/32 (ii)
(iii)/36/41 (I) (ii) of the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act lodged on 12.09.2022 by the informant,
Nandan Kumar Singh.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, the vehicle was intercepted and 661.180 liters English wine was recovered/seized.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: Sikandar Ansari and Vikash Singh were apprehended.
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the F.I.R.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that his name has come in the confessional statement of Md. Sikandar Ansari who was arrested from the spot and both the accused persons who were apprehended alongwith the materials namely, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52348 of 2023(2)
dt.19-08-2023 Sikandar Ansari and Vikash Singh have since been released on bail by a co-ordinate Bench vide Cr. Misc. No. 66680 of 2022 (Annexure-2 to the petition), he is in custody since 07.07.2023 (as stated in paragraph 8 of the petition).
sentences._hearing_file: Rahul Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned APP vehemently opposes the prayer for bail stating that he has criminal antecedent.
